imports:
# Find the single different token in each of five rounds.
import random


def odd_render(app):
    # A finished game cannot accept more answers.
    cards = [getattr(app, "Card" + str(i)) for i in range(9)]
    if app.odd_round >= 5:
        app.PromptLabel.configure(text="Finished! Press Restart to play again.")
        for card in cards:
            card.configure(state="disabled")
    else:
        common, different = app.odd_rng.choice([("A", "B"), ("6", "9"), ("CAT", "CAR"), ("12", "21")])
        app.odd_target = app.odd_rng.randrange(9)
        for i, card in enumerate(cards):
            card.configure(text=different if i == app.odd_target else common, state="normal")
        app.PromptLabel.configure(text=f"Round {app.odd_round + 1}: find the odd one out")
    app.ScoreLabel.configure(text=f"Score: {app.odd_score} / 5")


def odd_reset(app):
    # Keep all state on the generated Application instance.
    app.odd_round = 0
    app.odd_score = 0
    app.FeedbackLabel.configure(text="Choose the different tile.")
    odd_render(app)


def odd_choose(app, index):
    # Each click completes one round, whether correct or incorrect.
    if app.odd_round >= 5:
        return
    correct = index == app.odd_target
    app.odd_score += int(correct)
    app.odd_round += 1
    app.FeedbackLabel.configure(text="Correct!" if correct else "That was not the different tile.")
    odd_render(app)
startup:
# Use an independent random generator for this game.
self.odd_rng = random.Random()
odd_reset(self)
